text:
Chris (Sales): Hey team — prospect wants to kick off a paid POC but needs SOC 2 artifacts + a short bridge note to satisfy procurement. They also asked about signing an NDA this afternoon. Can we turn something around?
Nina (Solutions Eng): We usually supply a redacted SOC 2 extract (scope + control results) behind NDA. Do we have a pre-redacted bundle ready?
Luis (AE): Customer (Olivia) said procurement will only accept an initial bridge letter to open the POC while legal finishes the NDA. They need the bridge letter to confirm the controls coverage.
Tara (Legal): We do not release SOC 2 files without an executed NDA. We can, however, issue a one-page bridge letter that summarizes scope, last audit date, and confirms Type II coverage. It should be explicit that it's for evaluation only.
ir-bot: Reminder: Audit artifacts must not include customer data or employee identifiers.
Chris (Sales): If Tara sends the NDA template, can Olivia sign it quickly? Olivia, are you able to sign today?
Olivia (Customer): We'll sign asap. Procurement prefers presigned S3 links to download artifacts.
Infra (Ops): We can produce a presigned GET link with 72-hour expiry. Recommend IP allowlist and time-limited access.
Priya (Prospect Sec): IP allowlist is required. Also prefer the bridge letter to state whether evidence is stored in a controlled data room and how to request extended access.
Tara (Legal): I'll include a clause in the NDA allowing scoped presigned access for redacted artifacts and note the audit firm and report period in the bridge letter. The bridge letter will not provide raw logs or internal tickets.
Nina (Solutions Eng): For the artifact set, suggest: system-overview-redacted.pdf, control-matrix-csv (redacted), and a 1-page scoping note. I'll scrub any internal hostnames.
Infra (Ops): After NDA executed we'll upload to staging bucket and post presigned URL. We'll enable server-side encryption (KMS) and access logging.
Chris (Sales): Timeline if NDA signed by 15:00 PT?
Tara (Legal): NDA sent now. If returned signed by 15:00 PT, infra can upload and I'll send the bridge letter + presigned link by 18:00 PT. If they need longer access than 72h, procurement must request a separate docusign approval.
Priya (Prospect Sec): Can the bridge letter include confirmation of SOC 2 scope covering production GPU clusters, access controls, and change management?
Tara (Legal): Yes, high-level confirmation only. No sample evidence will be attached. We'll offer a follow-up secure review in a virtual data room for expanded due diligence.
ir-bot: Security note: do not include PII or detailed incident timelines in any artifact.
Olivia (Customer): We'll send IP ranges and counter-signed NDA this afternoon. One more: can the presigned URL be restricted to our corp IPs only?
Infra (Ops): Yes — we'll apply IP allowlist on the presigned link. Please put the IP CIDRs in the NDA cover email.
Luis (AE): Chris — can you track this in the opportunity? Make sure Legal and Infra are tagged.
Chris (Sales): Will do. Next steps: 1) Tara sends NDA, 2) Olivia returns signed NDA + IPs, 3) Infra uploads redacted bundle, 4) Tara sends bridge letter + presigned link. Goal: prospect can start POC by Wed morning.
Nina (Solutions Eng): I'll review the bridge letter for technical accuracy once Tara drafts it.
Tara (Legal): Drafting now, will ping for one quick technical check.
ir-bot: Log: SOC2-request-1945212345 created.
Chris (Sales): Thanks all — I'll follow up after upload. :rocket:
